basics.name: Burooj Rashid
basics.label: Product Engineer
basics.summary: Product engineer who takes ideas to shipped, tested, documented products. Four years of frontend leadership: nearly three years as sole frontend lead at API3, then contract builds including the workflow editor for an AI-automation startup. Since late 2025 I have built AI-native tools end to end: a browser extension and MCP server that archives AI conversations, a model-comparison harness, and an agent-orchestration control plane. I build with Claude Code and Codex agent teams; I set architecture, review, and merge.

projects.name: chat-scrobbler
projects.description: A self-built system that captures every conversation across ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini into one canonical, self-owned local store: a browser extension pulls each conversation through the provider's own API into a local ingest server, indexes it in SQLite FTS5 (with optional semantic embeddings), and exposes read-only search/get/list over a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server so AI agents and MCP clients can recall history directly. Includes multi-target backup fanout and a per-provider parser architecture designed so adding a new AI provider only requires one new parser.

projects.name: xPay2 — ETHGlobal New Delhi 2025 Hackathon
projects.description: Frontend for xPay2, a proxy service that turns any existing API into a paid endpoint with zero backend changes: developers paste a backend URL, set a price, and get a paid public endpoint powered by the HTTP 402 / x402 protocol with USDC payments on Base. Features a prepaid credit system for instant gasless requests and EIP-712 signature auth.
